{{Top}}
'''Static discharge vanes''' were used aboard [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigates]], such as the ''[[Far Orbit]]'', to release high amounts of energy in the ship's systems that could prove dangerous.
